svg.text: One vehicle frame. Six independently surveyed cameras.
Overhead planning layout | Range bands are centered on the vehicle origin, not on each camera.
Source: vehicle_camera_calibration_measurement_plan.md | Illustrative geometry; no measured camera poses.
Board icons = example locations; each camera needs at least six varied placements.
Purple points = candidate ground checks. Visibility must be confirmed in real images.
FOV labels have no confirmed axis type.
Arrows show direction only. Camera positions,
yaw, pitch, roll and vehicle size are illustrative.
At least four stable controls; redundant checks.
Survey all four hub centers and the ground.
Survey O/A/B/C at every stationary placement.
Tie each camera to the same vehicle frame.
About six per observable range band;
test near 10 m where actually visible.
